items.title: 8+ years on the creator side of brand deals (and a couple on the brand side) taught me that creator marketing at scale can be a nightmare.
items.description:
8+ years on the creator side of brand deals (and a couple on the brand side) taught me that creator marketing at scale can be a nightmare.

So we built CreatorGrid to take the friction out of doing creator marketing at scale, with zero upfront cost for brands (whilst also providing brand deals with 0% commission for creators).

We've been running campaigns with brands like Notion, Wispr Flow, Superhuman amongst others and we've just opened up a few more spots for new brands (apply here if you're interested: https://t.co/HWutug3ecC)

items.title: hey gang - we're looking for an experienced Sales Manager to join our Lifestyle Business Academy team. Our mission with LBA is to build the world’s best online business school, as an alternative to traditional MBA programs.
items.description:
hey gang - we're looking for an experienced Sales Manager to join our Lifestyle Business Academy team. Our mission with LBA is to build the world’s best online business school, as an alternative to traditional MBA programs.

I’ve seen first hand how a lifestyle business can change your life and I’ve wanted to create a programme that helps people find the same financial, time and creative freedom for a number of years.

We’re looking for someone who’s aligned with the mission and genuinely cares about the results that students get from the education that we provide. 

If you're interested, you can get more information and apply here: https://t.co/eAgmYYB7or

(And if you know anyone who should see this, please do share it with them - thanks 🙏)
